description_en: Renews an O\\\&M token for one hour
description_zh: 您可以通过该接口续期运维令牌，单次可将运维令牌续期1小时
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost renew-asset-operation-token --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewAssetOperationToken

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the O\&M token that you want to renew.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758861.html operation to query the O\&M token ID
parameters.help_zh:
要续期的运维令牌ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758861.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: token_id
